name: Losartan
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 50 mg once daily; up to 100 mg once daily; 25 mg start if possible volume depletion (e.g., on diuretics)
50 mg once daily; add HCTZ 12.5 mg and/or increase to 100 mg, then HCTZ 25 mg as needed
50 mg once daily; increase to 100 mg once daily for blood pressure

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Potassium-raising drugs (potassium supplements, potassium-sparing diuretics, salt substitutes)

key_interactions.effect: Worse kidney function, possible acute renal failure (older, volume-depleted or CKD patients); weaker antihypertensive effect.
Dual RAS blockade: hypotension, hyperkalemia, kidney function changes.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: ACE inhibitors, other ARBs, aliskiren (dual RAS blockade)
key_interactions.effect: More hypotension, syncope, hyperkalemia and acute renal failure; no added benefit in VA NEPHRON-D.
key_interactions.action: Avoid routine combination; monitor blood pressure, kidney function and electrolytes if used.

serious: Hypotension in volume- or salt-depleted patients
Kidney function deterioration, including acute renal failure

contraindications: Coadministration with aliskiren in patients with diabetes
monitoring: Kidney function periodically, especially with renal artery stenosis, CKD, severe heart failure or volume depletion
Stop at once if pregnancy is detected

pk.peak: Losartan 1 hour; active metabolite 3 to 4 hours
pk.half_life_eskd: Not reported; AUC 50% to 90% higher at CrCl 30 to 74 mL/min (label)
pk.vd: Losartan about 34 L; metabolite about 12 L
pk.metabolism: CYP2C9 and CYP3A4; about 14% converted to the active carboxylic acid metabolite
pk.dialyzability: No: neither losartan nor its active metabolite is removed by hemodialysis (label).

sources.citation: Organon LLC. (2026). COZAAR (losartan potassium) [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, NDA020386, set ID 9949448f-c3b9-44ee-94ed-c1aca8c90f39, version effective January 20, 2026]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.

draft_notes: Half-life and urinary excretion are absent from the stored COZAAR PK text (the HYZAAR label gives losartan about 2 h, metabolite 6 to 9 h; 4% unchanged and 6% as metabolite in urine). Decide whether to cross-use the HYZAAR label for these fields.
